note: MT State Park on Ackley Lake, ~7 mi SW of Hobson. Rustic sites with picnic tables and fire rings, two boat launches and a dock; large open sites fit any RV. --Claude
summary: FWP park page confirms 26 first-come rustic sites with no electricity/water/dump, vault toilets, no potable water (derived values now verified); campground open year-round already manual. Fees left as recorded (2024 FWP notice; the park page gives only the statewide '$4-$34' range). The inherited 7-night limit is on the statewide fee page, not the park's, so left inherited. Note trimmed of FCFS/hookup/toilet restatements.
